item.title: Enovix Realigns Operations Leadership Ahead Of Malaysia Mass Production Ramp
item.description: Enovix announced it is reshaping its operations leadership as it moves toward mass production of its silicon anode batteries, with a focus on “proven, high volume battery manufacturing leadership” and clearer operational accountability as the company prepares to scale output for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, and other IoT markets. item.title: NAMM Adds Eight New Directors As 2026 Board Class Begins Three-Year Term
item.description: NAMM, the National Association of Music Merchants, announced eight newly elected directors who will join the organization’s Board of Directors in 2026, with each set to serve a three year term running through January 2029. The announcement was made at the 2026 NAMM Show during the association’s annual meeting of members. item.title: GM To Shift Buick Envision Production From China To U.S.
item.description: General Motors will end production in China of the Buick Envision, a midsize SUV it has imported into the United States for nearly a decade, and will instead manufacture the next generation of the vehicle at its assembly plant in the Kansas City area starting in 2028, Reuters reported. item.title: Enechain: Japan Power Trading Startup Raises About $32 Million, Says Report
item.description: Japan power trading startup enechain has raised ¥5.05 billion (about $31.9 million) in an additional funding round to support business expansion. The round includes investors such as Soros Capital Management and Coreline Ventures, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.
